text.title: Two Hands, One Chart

laps.title: Two Hands, One Chart: a Session Board

stations.title: Call for a canvas
stations.prompt: You want a board of your own in this session. How do you ask for it?

options.text: Type `/` in the prompt box, select `/create-canvas`, then paste the description
options.result: A blank slate goes up on the easel.

options.text: Ask in chat for "a board", with no command

options.reason: That reloads canvases that exist. This one has not been made yet.

hints: Type `/`, select `/create-canvas`, then paste the description.

stations.title: Word the order
stations.prompt: Petra chalks the order for a simple, user-scoped Session Board. Which lines belong in it?

tiles.text: A checklist with Plan, Implement, and Validate
A Notes section with Next decision and Blocker fields
Let both the user and the agent update the checklist and notes
Do not edit repository files, run commands, or write to GitHub while creating the canvas
Buttons that run the tests and the build
tiles.reason: This board does not run tests or edit the app. Buttons that ask the agent to run development tasks come in the next exercise.

tiles.text: Commit the board to the repository
tiles.reason: It is user-scoped. Creating a user-scoped canvas does not change repository files.

stations.title: Your hand
stations.prompt: The canvas is open, with its proposal, checklist and notes. What do you do on it?

options.text: Enter a short feature proposal, mark **Plan** complete, and add a next decision
options.result: Your marks are on the slate.

options.text: Mark Plan, Implement and Validate complete, so the board looks done
options.reason: Nothing has been implemented or validated. The board should show the state the work is in.

options.text: Leave the board, and type the proposal into chat
options.reason: Then it is a buried chat sentence again. The board is where you and the agent both look.

hints: A proposal, one checked item, one note.
Enter a proposal, mark **Plan** complete, add a next decision.

stations.title: The mate’s hand
stations.prompt: You submit the prompt `Summarize the current Session Board state.` What do you check?

options.text: That the agent’s answer matches my updates
options.result: Juno reads the slate back, mark for mark, and pins a note beside yours.

options.text: Only that it answered at all
options.reason: Confirm that the agent’s answer matches your updates.

options.text: That it ran the tests while it was there
options.reason: The board does not run tests or edit the app.

hints: It reads the same board you marked.
Compare its answer with your marks.
Confirm that the answer matches your updates.

stations.title: Where it’s kept
stations.prompt: You open the **Changes** tab in the review panel. What does it list?

options.result: The slate goes in your own sea chest. Nothing was added to the repository.

options.text: The canvas’s files, waiting to be committed
options.reason: Creating a user-scoped canvas does not change repository files.

options.text: Nothing: there’s no **Changes** tab, so I skip the check
options.reason: If the tab is not open, select **+** (**Add tab**), then **Changes**.
